measurements.raw_user_statement:
PetSafe Receiver supply while VREF reads zero / v0.9.39
B62 red RX / black G (Powered, same red-blinking state; PIR connected): 0.066

interpretation: TP5/H_RX_VDD measured 66 mV relative to GND. This supports low receiver-supply availability in the reported red-blinking state, consistent with the separate VREF=0 V reading. It does not establish why the supply is low, prove Q7 is faulty or off, prove VREF is shorted to GND, or exclude brief switching pulses. Stability was not reported.
